title: Campus Tycoon 3D
description: Build and manage your dream campus from a single classroom into a bustling academy—enroll students, upgrade lecture halls and sports fields, and grow your tuition empire.
controls: Tap facilities to expand classrooms, hire teachers, collect tuition income, and upgrade campus zones.

zh-CN.title: 校园大亨模拟器
zh-CN.description: 超上头 3D 校园模拟经营：从一间小教室起步，招生上课、扩建操场食堂与宿舍楼，一路升级打造顶级名校帝国！
zh-CN.controls: 点击扩建教室与校园设施、招募名师并收取学费收益，持续升级打造顶级校园。
